gates.source: Not §7. PARAMETERS.md §1's sub-centimetre claim, held to the centimetre it names.

cuts.what: The 4032x3024 phone point runs at ONE seed, tripod only.
cuts.why: About 12 minutes per solve on this box, and the handheld arm would have doubled it. Two points would have cost 24 minutes for one bit of dispersion.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: No dispersion at the top resolution. The conclusion about phones therefore rests on the 2560x1920 point (2 seeds) and the trend below it, with 4032x3024 as a single confirming draw rather than a measured mean.

cuts.what: 2560x1920 runs at 2 seeds and 1280x960 at 3, against 5 everywhere cheap.
cuts.why: Capture cost is quadratic in the linear resolution: one 3-camera point is ~5 min at 2560x1920 against ~9 s at 320x240.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: The dispersion estimate at the two finest resolutions is weak. Where the finding quotes a spread at those points it quotes the observed range and says n.

cuts.what: The resolution axis holds the correspondence cap at 1500 per (camera, projector) pair.
cuts.why: Uncapping it makes the solve cost grow with the sensor and turns one axis into two.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: The resolution axis measures per-correspondence PRECISION, not correspondence COUNT. The `cap-control` figure measures the difference directly rather than inheriting A-12's claim about it.

cuts.what: Camera count is swept at 320x240 only.
cuts.why: The count axis is 36 camera-units per condition per seed; at 640x480 the sweep alone would have been about an hour per condition.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: The count sweep is measured at the corpus operating point, which is coarser than a phone. The resolution axis covers the other direction, but the CROSS — does a fourth photograph buy more at 4032x3024 than at 320x240 — is not measured.

cuts.what: Only the geometric half of the pipeline is scored.
cuts.why: PARAMETERS.md §10 and the ARCHITECTURE phase gate: every photometric constant is ASSUME or MEAS, so a photometric number here would be a statement about an unmeasured constant.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: Nothing. Experiment 1 is purely geometric by design and its outputs carry no PROVISIONAL marking.

cuts.what: Projector count is held at 4 and the rig at PARAMETERS.md §2 nominal.
cuts.why: The bench corpus already covers N=2 and N=3 (archetypes 7 and 8) and A-10 records what they do to the unlit gate.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: The answer to "how many photos" is stated for a four-projector install. A three-projector install has fewer parameters and one fewer seam; the count answer there is not measured.
